Definition: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
BiblicalUsage: 1) rod, staff, branch, offshoot, club, sceptre, tribe; 1a) rod, staff; 1b) shaft (of spear, dart); 1c) club (of shepherd's implement); 1d) truncheon, sceptre (mark of authority); 1e) clan, tribe
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
